title: Polydopamine enhances the photocatalytic performance of a BiOBr-loaded 3D-printed monolithic photoreactor by fused deposition modeling
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17351-17359
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01291D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fengrui Wu, Yan Li, Wenxiu Wu, Zhipeng Zhang, Liangbin Lin, Songwei Yang, Lihong Xu, Xinshu Xia, Weiming Zhou, Changlin Cao, Liren Xiao
BiOBr modified with polydopamine was loaded onto a 3D-printed monolithic photoreactor. The optimized photocatalyst achieved 95.0% RhB degradation within 1 h and retained 90.0% efficiency after 10 cycles, demonstrating its excellent stability.
